findings.title: reentrancy-benign
findings.rationale:
Reentrancy in FlashFarm.fund(uint256) (casework/contracts/FlashFarm.sol#55-58):
	External calls:
	- rewardToken.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (casework/contracts/FlashFarm.sol#56)

	- rewardPool += amount (casework/contracts/FlashFarm.sol#57)

findings.title: divide-before-multiply
findings.rationale:
PawnShop._withinLimit(address) (casework/contracts/HallOfMirrors.sol#164-168) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- value = (pledged[who] * feed.stakePriceInCash()) / 1e18 (casework/contracts/HallOfMirrors.sol#165)
	- ceiling = (value * LOAN_TO_VALUE_BPS) / 10_000 (casework/contracts/HallOfMirrors.sol#166)
